page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-30-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance within the c3d family. It features 30 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 15 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 240.0 GB of system memory, providing a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 804 GB of NVMe SSD capacity across two local drives. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2864.57 placing it in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance is average, scoring 43041.35 in stress-ng. Memory performance is mixed; while the PassMark memory score is strong at 2792.8, uncached large-block memory write bandwidth is weak at 25.09 GB/sec, representing a potential bottleneck for write-heavy memory operations. Read-only memory bandwidth remains average at 72.09 GB/sec for large blocks. The system demonstrates average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations at 38.76 million operations per second, and software compilation.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and integrated NVMe SSD storage, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space without the overhead of external storage. The hardware is suited for database hosting, in-memory caching, and text processing. It also supports moderate machine learning tasks, showing strong text generation speeds of 314.87 tokens per second for small 135M models, though performance scales down to average for larger models.
